rationale: At the 0.45 floor every run is reg-to-reg limited at ss 100C max-RC. Hold is positive with 0 buffers, DRC is clean and slew/cap is 0 pins against a bar of 953, so only path delay matters. Raising margins from 0.2 to 0.4 changed nothing. Placement variants (52% density, routability, TDP off) all lost 0.13-0.22 ns, so the AREA 3 netlist looks exhausted. The other good family, DELAY 4 without ABC buffering/sizing, reached 8.08 in a weaker placement. Setting 1 gives DELAY 4 (SOP depth balancing) ABC buffering/sizing and the best placement (TDP, 41%, both post-GRT repairs). Setting 2 tries DELAY 0 (&nf delay mapping) the same way. Both keep cap213, whose pessimism gave 0.4-0.8 ns over-delivery versus 0.1-0.3 ns for stock/orfs.
